spec.situation_desc: transferred money to someone pretending to be from the bank
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Harriet Quigley. Someone pretending to be from your bank talked me into transferring money, and I’m really unhappy about how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m very sorry this has happened, Harriet. I’ll take this seriously and help you with it. Before we discuss any account details, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Harriet May Quigley, and it’s the 14th of February 1952.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And what’s the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s verified. I’m sorry you’ve been put through this. Can you tell me a little about what happened?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: They rang saying there was a problem with my account and told me to move £2,400 to keep it safe. I did it on Tuesday. I don’t really understand online banking; my son normally does it for me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and thank you for explaining. I can arrange for our Financial Support team to help you through the process, and we can allow extra time for anything you need to do. Would either of those be helpful?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The extra time would help, and I’d like someone to explain things simply. I’m angry that this happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’m sorry this has left you feeling that way. I’m logging this as a complaint about what happened and your experience with us. I can’t promise what the outcome will be, but we’ll look into it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the complaint to our complaints team today and note that you’d like clear explanations and extra time. I’ll also ask the Financial Support team to contact you by 5pm tomorrow to discuss support. The complaints team will investigate and send you a full written response within 15 business days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And if I don’t hear from the Financial Support team by then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: If they haven’t contacted you by 5pm tomorrow, call us and ask for me, Zara, and I’ll follow it up. I’ll make sure your request is recorded today.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay, so you’re logging the complaint today, they’ll write to me within 15 business days, and Financial Support should call by tomorrow at five?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s right. Does that make sense, and is there anything you’d like me to go over again?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. Thank you for being patient.
